controls.name: C-14d
controls.query:
FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-12T19:02:22.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-12T20:02:22.000Z"
        AND host.name == "web-1"
        AND message LIKE "*sudo:*"
| KEEP @timestamp, user.name, message
| SORT @timestamp ASC
| LIMIT 20
